versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the guaikei-kuaishou-hashtag-video-fetcher skill.
- Enables searching Kuaishou videos by keyword, fetching creator post lists, and retrieving video comments.
- Outputs structured JSON data for trend insight, competitor analysis, and KOL discovery—no Kuaishou login required.
- Only processes Kuaishou public data, not private/hidden content or other platforms.
- Usage requires a valid GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
